data.title: 户隐憧子 · 庭院花房的亚麻长裙小憩
data.description: 阳光透过玻璃花房的雕花窗格，斑驳光影洒在盛开的白山茶花丛间。憧子身穿一袭素雅的淡青色亚麻连衣裙，坐在藤编摇椅上轻摇茶匙。微风吹散了几缕鬓发，她微红着脸颊抬起视线，往常从容淡定的学姐在独处时光中，流露出只属于此刻的温柔心动。
data.location: vintage botanical greenhouse with white camellias and wicker furniture
data.action: relaxing on wicker armchair in sunlit garden greenhouse, elegant linen dress, holding tea saucer, soft warm expression looking at viewer
data.lighting: dappled afternoon sunlight filtering through botanical glass panes
data.mood: elegant garden tranquility, deeply endearing mature warmth
data.promptProse: Relaxing in a wicker armchair inside a sunlit greenhouse filled with white camellias, Touko wears an elegant linen dress. Afternoon sunbeams illuminate her black hair as she lifts her teacup with gentle, affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Touko enjoying afternoon tea in a sunlit botanical greenhouse, smiling gently in a linen dress.
